anjali.s: Quick q — for BYOK customers doing HSM key imports, what telemetry can we safely collect without touching key material? Example: import success/fail, wrapped blob ids/hash, import error stack traces. Need to align with Legal/Compliance before we ship any enhanced logging.

mike: Good question. Infra currently emits import events but we don't store the wrapped blob. Are hashed blob IDs acceptable? cc @jessie for compliance.

samir: We must not log raw base64 of wrapped keys. Hashing (sha256) + truncating to a fixed-length digest for correlation is probably OK, but needs legal sign-off. Also watch out for `key_label` leakage if customers use PII in labels.

jessie: From a SOC2/privacy standpoint: no sensitive crypto material in logs. Hashed identifiers are OK if irreversible and can't be used to reconstruct material. For PCI-scope customers we should be extra conservative: allowed audit fields = [customer_id (opaque), key_label (optional), algo, import_event_type]. For wrapped blob we can permit `wrapped_key_digest` as `sha256_trunc16` (first 16 hex chars) only.

anjali.s: Can someone sketch a minimal audit-event schema we can push into the system that meets those constraints? Ops, any runtime objections?

ops-bot: Suggested audit event schema (do NOT include raw wrapped blob):
```json
{
  "event_type": "IMPORT_ATTEMPT | IMPORT_SUCCESS | IMPORT_FAILURE",
  "timestamp": "iso8601",
  "customer_id": "opaque-customer-guid",
  "key_label": "sanitized-string-or-null",
  "algo": "RSA-2048 | AES-256-GCM",
  "wrapped_key_digest": "sha256_first16hex-or-null",
  "error_code": "optional-short-code",
  "handler_id": "service-instance-id"
}
```
Also runtime config to disable verbose HSM client debugging: `hsm_client.debug_logging = false`. If you need to enable for debug, rotate logs and ensure retention is short.

mike: That schema works. Implementation note: this will require updating our ingest parsers and dashboards (alerts that look for IMPORT_FAILURE spikes). Effort ~1 day + testing.

samir: We also need RBAC changes: restrict access to raw import logs to `security-admin` and `legal` roles. Add a guardrail so developers cannot pull historic logs with wrapped_key_digest > threshold without approval.

anjali.s: @samir can you open a ticket to add the RBAC guardrail + update runbooks? I'll loop in @jessie and @mike. Also devs: please avoid printing `wrapped_blob` or `key_material` in exceptions — add sanitizer in `hsm-client` (PR checklist item).

jessie: :thumbsup: We'll draft a short privacy blurb for BYOK onboarding docs and confirm language for SOC2/PCI customers. Also make sure HSM attestation artifacts (certs/keystore dumps) are never indexed into the normal logging pipeline.

mike: I'll add a CI lint rule to fail builds if any test logs contain `wrapped_key` or `key_material` strings. Also update parsers.

samir: One last ops -> incident response note: if an import fails with suspected leakage, rotate any ephemeral import keys within 24 hours and escalate to incident commander. I'll draft the small playbook.

anjali.s: Thanks all. Action items recap: 1) samir open RBAC + playbook ticket, 2) mike update parsers & CI lint, 3) jessie draft privacy blurb and signoff checklist, 4) devs add sanitizer in `hsm-client`. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to finalize wording for logs and onboarding.
